data.name: Samantha
data.gender_notes: Samantha is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Probably from the Aramaic sh-m-ʿ, 'to hear' — 'listener'. Its root is Aramaic sh-m-ʿ. A modern English given name. Samantha is a Aramaic name meaning “Listener; (also) God has heard”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Samantha expresses “Listener; (also) God has heard”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Probably from the Aramaic sh-m-ʿ, 'to hear' — 'listener'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samantha total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
